milestones.title: Product and commercial definition
milestones.exit_gate: Buyer evidence, chosen initial segment, named owners and actual cost cap recorded; no real-data processing.

milestones.title: Supplier and processing feasibility
milestones.exit_gate: Contracted or explicitly selected pilot route with no unresolved disqualifying rights/location issue; privacy assessment plan approved.

milestones.title: Secure platform foundation
milestones.exit_gate: AT-01/02 pass; CI, role revocation and environment separation demonstrated.

milestones.title: Applicant sessions and contact checks
milestones.exit_gate: AT-03/04/15/23 pass; no client-authoritative success or unbounded messaging.

milestones.title: Identity evidence and decision pipeline
milestones.exit_gate: AT-05/06/07/11 pass; result provenance and no approval on technical errors proven.

milestones.title: Review, privacy and security readiness
milestones.exit_gate: AT-08/09/10/24 pass; no unresolved critical/high issue; lawful processing and accountable review established.

milestones.title: Controlled commercial pilot
milestones.exit_gate: AT-12/13 pass; actual pilot evidence supports commercial direction and captures gaps without invented accuracy claims.

milestones.title: General availability
milestones.exit_gate: AT-14 plus full regression pass; scope-limited launch signed with actual evidence and support capacity.

milestones.title: Supplemental Document AI
milestones.exit_gate: AT-16 passes; extraction never masquerades as authenticity; approved module economics and data lifecycle.

milestones.title: Authoritative database checks
milestones.exit_gate: AT-17 passes; access is contracted and no-match is not automatically fraud.

milestones.title: NFC document assurance
milestones.exit_gate: AT-18 passes; decoded-only chip data cannot receive authenticated status.

milestones.title: Age assurance
milestones.exit_gate: AT-19 passes; specialist review and use-case compliance assessment completed before real minor data.

milestones.title: Digital ID and EUDI
milestones.exit_gate: AT-20 passes; named scheme onboarding and protocol conformance evidenced.

milestones.title: Selective proprietary replacement
milestones.exit_gate: AT-21 passes; gate may conclude continued licensing is preferable; no automatic model replacement.

milestones.title: Managed review and market expansion
milestones.exit_gate: AT-22 passes; operational staffing and exact regulatory/service scope match commercial claims.
